summary: Describes content the diffusion model should avoid. It materially affects generation and must be reconciled with Lixpi's authoritative prompt, moderation, retry, and multi-transport routing before it can be accepted as a separate user field.
combines: It is evaluated with the positive prompt; contradictory positive and negative instructions can reduce quality or produce unstable results.
It does not bypass provider moderation or Lixpi's provider-safe prompt boundary.

A separate user-authored negative field must preserve authoritative prompt ownership and behave consistently across direct Stability and Bedrock transports, which is why the registry keeps it out of this implementation.
note: Requires a separate prompt-authority and cross-provider configuration feature; not implemented in this iteration.
